patterns: APPSC asks AP irrigation data as single figures from the Socio-Economic Survey / Economy in Brief (GIA/GCA = 52%; wells the main source).
Pattiseema is asked through 'NOT true' statement sets and 'beneficiary = Krishna delta'.
PMKSY components are a favourite 'NOT a component' item (National Water Grid is the odd one out).
Programmes are asked by state and year (Neeru-Meeru = AP, 2000; Jalayagnam = Tenth Plan); project-river-district matches (Vamsadhara = Srikakulam).
The app adds many long 3-statement items on 2024-26 figures (micro-irrigation, groundwater, White Paper), deeper than the PYQs.
